release: Wanted Upgrade Reasoning & Cutoff Policy Fix
name: Wanted Upgrade Reasoning & Cutoff Policy Fix
changes: Separates base quality cutoff, release-source specificity and preferred dynamic range when deciding whether an existing library file still needs an upgrade.

Stops Allow-only dynamic-range policies from being treated as mandatory terminal upgrade targets; 1080p Balanced files at 1080p WEB-DL no longer become false Wanted upgrades solely because they are SDR.
Keeps the 4K Preferred SDR to HDR to Dolby Vision to Dolby Vision + HDR fallback progression when the profile explicitly marks those dynamic-range states Prefer or Require.
Makes Wanted explain the real upgrade dimension instead of rendering contradictions such as Current 2160p WEB-DL has not reached 2160p WEB-DL.
Adds explicit Wanted paths for base-quality, WEB to WEB-DL source, and dynamic-range upgrades and keeps manual/automatic release evaluation on the same policy target.
Recomputes derived cutoff flags in live Library and Calendar responses so stale pre-v3.6.84 cutoff_met booleans do not leave the UI showing obsolete upgrade states until another library scan.
Carries v3.6.83 About/update-version coherency, v3.6.81 quality-profile behavior, and the canonical source-tag-trigger release pipeline forward unchanged outside this targeted fix.
Preserves frozen Newsgroup Browser tuning, SABnzbd 5.1.2, Smart Import/post-processing, Metadata Server v0.3.3, Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31 and the Defender-clean yEnc pipeline.
regression_guards: v3.6.84 pins the reviewed Automation engine, UI and versioned payload hashes and exercises contradictory-Wanted regression cases.
Allow-only dynamic-range policy values must never create an upgrade requirement; Prefer/Require values may define a terminal upgrade target.
1080p Balanced 1080p WEB-DL SDR must satisfy cutoff, while 4K Preferred 2160p WEB-DL SDR remains an explicitly explained preferred dynamic-range upgrade.
Generic WEB at an explicit WEB-DL cutoff remains upgradeable without claiming that its base quality tier is below cutoff.
Wanted must never emit the identical-quality has-not-reached-identical-quality contradiction for same-tier source or dynamic-range upgrades.
v3.6.81 WEB-DL preference and SDR to HDR to Dolby Vision to Dolby Vision + HDR fallback progression remain guarded for profiles that explicitly prefer those states.
v3.6.83 installed/runtime/UI version coherency and same-version update protection remain guarded.
The canonical Source commit trigger parser/writer and source -> annotated tag -> trigger topology remain fail-closed, with frozen browser/yEnc/SAB behavior unchanged.
